events.caption: First contact exchanges the colors; object identities stay fixed.
Push B back from its current position; the second collision swaps colors back.

setup: Two contacts in one continuous run. After the first collision, push object B back from its current position.
name: Contact color swap

oracle.name: Contact color swap
oracle.law: Free single-sphere bodies swap colors once at the onset of each separate contact.
oracle.plain: When two balls touch, they swap colors.
oracle.plain_zh: 两个球一接触，就交换颜色。
oracle.formula: (color A, color B) → (color B, color A)
oracle.condition: Two free single-sphere bodies begin a new contact.
oracle.effect: Their colors swap once. Their object identities do not swap.
oracle.scope: Sustained contact does not repeat the swap. Separation followed by renewed contact does.

reference: Identical initial preparation and impulses, with the altered program disabled.
